items.title: German far-right set for big win in eastern state - projections
items.description: Germany's AfD has hailed a "historic result" and is projected to win more than 44% of the vote, far ahead of the conservative CDU on 18.4%.

items.title: Saxony-Anhalt: Far-right AfD secures huge lead in key vote
items.description: The far-right AfD has taken a massive lead at the Saxony-Anhalt election, although it was not clear if it will be able to form government. The party's state leader said the result sends "a signal to Berlin." Follow DW.

items.title: German company successfully launches rocket to space
items.description: Bavaria-based Isar Aerospace managed to launch its Spectrum rocket into orbit, 18 months after its first attempt. This is the first such launch from European soil.

items.title: Zelensky says he expects war to continue into winter after talks with US envoys
items.description: Talks finished without an announcement of a major breakthrough, after Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner travelled to Kyiv.
